jobs.description:

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Knowledge Graph & LLM Engineer
to develop next-generation AI-powered engineering knowledge platforms for semiconductor design, manufacturing, and product development. This role focuses on building intelligent systems that enable engineers to instantly access technical knowledge across RTL design, Physical Design, Verification, DFT, Process Engineering, Manufacturing, Failure Analysis, Product Engineering, and Semiconductor R&D.

The successful candidate will design Knowledge Graphs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Large Language Model (LLM) applications, AI Agents, and enterprise search platforms
that transform engineering documentation, design history, silicon learning, manufacturing data, patents, and technical standards into actionable engineering intelligence.
This role sits at the intersection of Semiconductor Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Knowledge Management, and Enterprise Digital Transformation
.
Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI-powered engineering knowledge platforms for semiconductor organizations.
Build enterprise Knowledge Graphs connecting design documents, specifications, simulation data, silicon validation reports, manufacturing records, patents, engineering change orders (ECOs), failure analysis reports, and technical documentation.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for engineering search and intelligent question-answering.
Build AI assistants enabling engineers to retrieve design knowledge, debug history, process learnings, yield issues, and best practices.
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) with engineering repositories, PLM systems, document management systems, Git repositories, and EDA databases.
Develop semantic search engines using vector databases and embedding models.
Design AI Agents that automate engineering documentation, report generation, design reviews, knowledge extraction, and engineering workflows.
Collaborate with Design, Verification, CAD, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, Reliability, and IT teams to define enterprise AI knowledge strategies.
Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting engineering tools, manufacturing systems, and enterprise applications.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies for enterprise knowledge management and semiconductor engineering productivity.
Ensure security, governance, access control, and responsible AI practices for engineering knowledge systems.
Prepare technical documentation, architecture designs, and deployment strategies.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.
6 15 years of experience in AI Engineering, Enterprise Search, Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Development, or Semiconductor Engineering.
Strong understanding of semiconductor engineering workflows and engineering documentation.
Experience building AI or enterprise knowledge management platforms.
Strong programming and system architecture skills.

jobs.description:
Experience Required: 6+ years

Candidates with Immediate Availability Preferred

Role Description

The Camunda Developer will design, develop, and maintain BPMN workflows and process automation solutions using Camunda for client projects. On a typical day, this role involves collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to understand process requirements, modeling workflows, implementing integrations with backend systems and APIs, and ensuring performance, reliability, and security of automation solutions. The Camunda Developer will also troubleshoot issues, optimize existing workflows, and contribute to documentation and best practices. This is a contract role, structured as a hybrid position with a mix of on-site work and some work-from-home flexibility.

Key Responsibilities 

Design, develop, and implement BPMN 2.0 workflows and DMN decision models using Camunda
Lead end-to-end Camunda migration projects (e.g., Camunda 7 to Camunda 8, on-prem to Camunda SaaS/Cloud, or version upgrades)
Analyze existing process models, identify migration risks, and define migration strategy/roadmap
Develop custom Java delegates, connectors, and REST APIs integrating Camunda with external systems
Optimize process performance, exception handling, and error/incident management
Collaborate with business analysts and architects to translate business requirements into automated workflows
Configure and manage Camunda engine deployment, clustering, and job executor tuning
Conduct code reviews, unit testing, and support CI/CD pipelines for process application deployment
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers
Troubleshoot production issues and ensure high availability of BPM applications

Required Skills & Experience

6+ years of overall software development experience, with 4+ years dedicated to Camunda (BPM/Zeebe)
Proven hands-on experience with Camunda migration projects (Camunda 7 → 8, engine upgrades, or platform migration)
Strong expertise in BPMN 2.0, DMN, CMMN modeling- Proficiency in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, REST APIs
Experience with Camunda Modeler, Cockpit, Tasklist, and Optimize
Hands-on with Zeebe (for Camunda 8), gRPC, and job workers (if applicable)
Strong SQL/database skills (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar)
Experience with messaging/integration frameworks (Kafka, JMS, or similar)
Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes
Solid understanding of microservices architecture
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Good to Have 

Camunda Certification (Camunda Certified Developer/Professional)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
Knowledge of Elasticsearch, Prometheus/Grafana for monitoring
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies

About The Company

Quik Hire Staffing is a reputable staffing agency dedicated to connecting talented professionals with leading organizations across various industries. With a focus on quality and integrity, we strive to provide our clients with top-tier talent solutions that meet their evolving needs. Our commitment to excellence and personalized service has established us as a trusted partner in the recruitment industry. We pride ourselves on understanding the unique requirements of each role and ensuring a seamless hiring experience for both candidates and employers.

About The Role

We are currently seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer specializing in Ruby to join our client's dynamic team on a remote basis. The role involves working on cutting-edge projects focused on large language model (LLM) evaluation and repository validation. The ideal candidate will have a passion for software engineering and a keen interest in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications. This is a full-time position offering the flexibility of remote work, allowing you to collaborate with a global team from anywhere in the world.

The primary responsibilities involve building datasets for LLM evaluation, analyzing open-source code repositories, and developing robust testing environments. You will work closely with AI researchers and software engineers to create verifiable tasks from public repositories, ensuring comprehensive coverage across programming languages and difficulty levels. Your contributions will directly impact the development of AI tools that assist in software development and code quality assessment.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of three years of professional experience in software engineering, with a strong proficiency in Ruby and Ruby on Rails. Demonstrated expertise in version control systems such as Git, containerization tools like Docker, and familiarity with setting up reproducible software pipelines are essential. Candidates should have the ability to navigate complex, real-world codebases, modify code, and run tests locally. Experience with Ruby testing frameworks, including RSpec and Minitest, as well as gem management through Bundler, is required. Prior contributions to open-source projects or experience evaluating open-source repositories will be considered a significant advantage.

Responsibilities

Analyze and triage issues from GitHub repositories across trending open-source libraries to identify suitable evaluation scenarios for LLM testing.
Set up and configure code repositories, including containerizing environments using Docker to ensure reproducibility of tests.
Assess and improve unit test coverage and code quality metrics to maintain high standards of code health and robustness.
Modify, run, and debug Ruby codebases locally to evaluate the performance of language models in bug fixing and code completion tasks.
Collaborate with AI research teams to design challenging repository issues and select appropriate datasets for evaluation purposes.

Benefits

Joining our client's team offers numerous benefits, including flexible remote working arrangements, competitive compensation packages, and opportunities for professional growth in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will be part of a forward-thinking organization that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. The role provides exposure to cutting-edge AI research and the chance to contribute to projects that shape the future of software development tools and benchmarks. Additionally, employees benefit from a supportive work environment, access to ongoing training, and the opportunity to work with a diverse and talented global team.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer – Product Development
jobs.description:
At ICSBit Labs
, we're building the future of industrial cybersecurity — from manufacturing plants to energy utilities. We're a Bengaluru-based team working on industrial automation and cybersecurity, with deep protocol expertise (Modbus, DNP3, Profinet, BACnet) and a founder-led understanding of what it actually takes to secure OT environments aligned to IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and NIS2.

We're looking for software engineers who enjoy build systems that operate in the demanding, latency-sensitive, protocol-heavy world of industrial networks — not another SaaS CRUD app.

If you're excited by hard technical problems with real-world industrial stakes — where a bug isn't just an inconvenience but could affect a power grid or a factory floor — we want to talk to you.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain backend and frontend features.
Build REST APIs and work with databases.
Work with network traffic, PCAP files, and protocol data.
Debug product, networking, and application issues.
Write unit and integration tests.
Work in Linux and use Git for development.
Analyze logs and reproduce issues.
Learn and work with OT/industrial protocols when required.

Qualifications

Go and Python.
Basic React / TypeScript / JavaScript.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, TCP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, ports, routing, and switching.
Wireshark or tcpdump.
Basic PCAP analysis.
REST APIs and JSON.
SQLite or PostgreSQL.
Linux and Git.
Basic cybersecurity and networking knowledge.
Exposure to Modbus, OPC UA, S7, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, BACnet, DNP3, or IEC-104 is a plus.
Good debugging and problem-solving skills.

Note:- This is NOT an AI/ ML position and we are NOT looking for vibe coders. Although, we encourage usage of AI tools for coding assistance, but we really check blocks of code you are writing and what's your logic to solve the problem. Quality of code is what matters to us.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Yolex Labs is an intelligence ecosystem that embeds forward-deployed engineers within client organizations to solve real problems rather than simply delivering dashboards. The company builds two core products: Candoor, which runs short, anonymous, AI-led voice interviews to surface issues people would not share in traditional surveys, and Storm, which simulates real roles to create live capability maps of what team members can actually do. These tools help organizations understand readiness for AI, identify internal mobility opportunities, and restructure by aligning people with meaningful work. Yolex Labs collaborates with researchers from Boston University, Indiana University, and IIT Kanpur, and is currently in beta with a select group of customers, including Fortune 500 companies.

Role Description
As a Junior Software Engineer at Yolex Labs, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of software components that power products like Candoor and Storm. You will write clean, testable code, participate in code reviews, and collaborate with senior engineers to implement backend services, APIs, and integrations. Daily work includes debugging issues, improving performance, and supporting deployment and monitoring of features in production environments. You will work closely with product and research teams to translate requirements into technical solutions and iterate based on feedback. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area.

Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and system design basics.
Proficiency in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with experience in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or similar).
Hands-on exposure to Software Development practices such as version control (Git), testing, debugging, and continuous integration.
Experience or coursework in Back-End Web Development, including APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to learn quickly, work collaboratively in cross-functional teams, and communicate clearly in spoken and written English.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, basic security practices, or AI/ML concepts is a plus.
